general_tips: Fourth gear primary setup, downshift to third gear at both ends of the track.
Shift point tricky due to aggressive downshifts on entry and back to fourth on exit.
Prepare for wheel spin on exit and wheel chatter on entry if shifts are not matched.
Tire management important but less critical than at Iowa due to lower temperatures.
